 (By Shri Nilesh Manore, Advocate)
 And
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Station House
 Officer Through Police Station Kishanganj
 Tehsil Mhow, Dist. Indore (Madhya Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri Gaurav Rawat, Government Advocate)
 (By Shri Ravi Sagre, Learned Counsel For The Complainant)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

(1) This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 relating to FIR No. 454/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Kishangaj,
District-Barwani for the offence under Sections 376 and 376(2) N of I.P.C. on behalf of the applicant-Raja.
(2) It is alleged that the applicant and prosecutrix got engaged and the applicant has made physical relation with the prosecuritx under the pretext of marriage.
( 3 ) Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is in jail since 14.05.2023.
The applicant and prosecutrix got engaged and marriage is to be organized.
He further submits that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. has not supported the prosecution's case.
Under these circumstances, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Shri Ravi Sagre, learned counsel for the complainant submits that the complainant has not objection to the prayer of grant of bail to the present applicant.

(4) Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State submits that the verification has been done of the affidavit given by the prosecutrix before the trial Court, as per earlier order dated 08.06.2023 and also stated that the prosecutrix has no objection to grant of bail to the applicant.

(5) After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and also fact that trial may take sufficient time, I am of the view that it is a case, in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

(6) It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
(7) This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
